newsitem.title: LEBANON: Civilian wounded in south Lebanon blast.
newsitem.headline: Civilian wounded in south Lebanon blast.

text.p: A roadside bomb exploded in south Lebanon on Sunday, wounding a civilian motorist, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said the blast took place on a road near the town of Jezzine in a finger of territory jutting north from a border zone Israel occupies in south Lebanon but under Israeli control.
It was not immediately known who was behind the blast.

Hours later, a second roadside bomb blew up as an SLA patrol passed near the village of Kfar Falous in the Jezzine area, SLA sources said. There was no report of casualties in the attack and no immediate claim of responsibility.
Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) fighters lead a guerrilla war against Israeli and SLA forces in a bid to drive them out from south Lebanon.
